summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature testing of Files page: animated Upload modal, multi-file sequential upload, drop overlay, and storage-switch race-condition fix. All targeted flows PASSED end-to-end against PREVIEW_sftp storage.
critical_code_review_comments: Files.jsx onDragLeave uses e.currentTarget === e.target which is fine for the outer wrapper, but with children the overlay may flicker on nested elements; consider tracking a counter for enter/leave to smooth the UX.
UploadDialog uses a single useEffect keyed to []; if files prop changes while dialog open it will not re-run. Currently safe because dialog unmounts between uploads, but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Created two small text files upload_test_1.txt / upload_test_2.txt on SFTP storage, deleted after test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) upload-file-button opens native file picker; setting 2 files opens upload-dialog with header 'Uploading files…' then transitions to 'Upload complete' 2/2 done with green checks + Done and X buttons; upload-list has one row per file with animated progress bar reaching 100%. (2) Closing via upload-done-button refreshes list and both uploaded files appear (file-row-<name>). (3) drop-overlay element renders when dragover event is dispatched on the drop container (verified programmatically since real HTML5 drop simulation is unreliable in Playwright). (4) Race-condition fix: clicking STAGING S3 then quickly PREVIEW_sftp results in final list matching PREVIEW_sftp (no stale S3 items). loading state clears + setItems([]) confirmed via reqId guard. (5) Regression: grid/list toggle works, notes.txt preview opens, delete-file-<name> works. No console errors. No backend issues.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously-reported race condition and upload UX items are fixed.
